author: naveen-u
body:
This PR adds `TGroup` as a possible log action.

### Files Changed
The following files have been modified:
* `kernel/model/mod.rs`: Action declaration
* `kernel/models/fields.rs`: Schema definition for the action
* `actions.rs`: Action definition

### `TGroup` Action
The `TGroup` action contains the following fields:
- `tgroup_uri`: URI of the T-group to which table is added.
- `timestamp`: Timestamp at which the log was added. When table is being added to a T-group, this lets us automatically assume failure after time *t*.
- `redirect_state`: Enum identifying the state of addition to T-group. Can take the following values:
  - `ReadOnly`: Readers can continue reading from the table as usual. Writers must block or retry. The log line is valid only up to time _t_ after the `timestamp` in the log.
  - `Redirect`: Readers and writers must use the T-group's logs.
  - `TimedOut`: Denotes that T-group creation failed. Readers and writers can use the table's logs. This is more of an informational line. (We can probably get rid of this later if we don't end up using it.)

author: jsm174
body:
The iOS and Android apps capture a snapshot of the screen whenever the table is quit or when the user touches the artwork button in the mobile LiveUI.

On iOS, we were getting a the Metal layer and then using an extension to convert it to a UIImage.

On Android, we were trying to get the Android surface from the SDL Activity.

Android is very sporadic on capture the image. Sometimes it would, but 99% of the time it doesn't. We tried all kinds of tricks (coroutine delays) with no luck.

As it turns out BGFX has the ability to capture a screenshot. So we decided to use that.

BGFX captures all the windows for it's metal renderer, see [here](https://github.com/bkaradzic/bgfx/issues/1833), [here](https://github.com/bkaradzic/bgfx/issues/3249).

After some trial an error we were able to get a patch working that seems to capture a window or the main screen: 
https://github.com/vbousquet/bgfx/commit/e4e6c9c0a2966f8b5a3901cffab5835cb4786d65

Capturing a screenshot results in a callback which we need to execute after a flip. Unfortunately I couldn't figure out how to implement this without using some static variables.

So to capture a screenshot, one would do:

```
g_pplayer->m_renderer->m_renderDevice->CaptureScreenshot(filename.c_str(),
      [](bool success) {
      });
```

We leverage this in iOS and Android by returning `CAPTURE_SCREENSHOT` events to the `VPinballManager` objects.

The screenshot will be saved using SDL3_image as a jpg or png, based upon the filename's extension. The callback is currently `#ifdef __STANDALONE__` as none of the Windows VPX isn't linking SDL3_image yet.

In addition to overhauling screen capture logic, the following other updates have been made:

- on iOS the artwork is no longer stored in SwiftData. Instead a <table>.jpg is placed next to the table. Now when exporting / importing a vpxz file, artwork will be included (to match Android)
- Android was updated to store the artwork as `<table>.jpg` as well.
- Removed creating a Metal Layer in swift and sending it to libvpinball. This now matches MacOS by using: `SDL_GetRenderMetalLayer`
- Fixed the Discord link to point to `#vpx-standalone-mobile` channel
- Added two new contributors to mobile Settings screens, @superhac + @Le-Syl21
- Set the default max texture dimensions on iOS to 1024
- Replace the default ZeDMD Wifi address in android from `192.168.4.1` to `zedmd-wifi.local`
- Fixed iOS simulator builds by properly creating the Bass Framework.
- Enabled logging for DMDUtil plugin

author: thomsontan
body:
## Changes

The parameter pack sent to `EmitLogRecord` is unpacked from right to left, which are caused by passing them as function parameters to template function `IgnoreTraitResult`. This will send the rightmost `attributes` parameter to the processor and then pass it to the `Recordable`. It makes it a little hard to do serialization in the `Recordable` interface, because the serialization usually needs to encode the data like event name or severity before encoding the attributes.

This PR changes the unpack order to help do serialization in the `Recordable` interface in a straightforward way, without caching any attributes.

Allows for more permissive (case insensitive, prefix) match for kubernetes when launching accelerators on kubernetes. Fixes https://github.com/skypilot-org/skypilot/issues/4860

**Case sensitivity**

For other clouds, case sensitivity is achieved by ignoring case when checking the user provided accelerator against available accelerators:
`sky/clouds/seervice_catalog/common.py:L525`
```
        fuzzy_result = df[
            (df['AcceleratorName'].str.contains(acc_name, case=False)) &
            (df['AcceleratorCount'] >= acc_count)]
```
